completion_claim: The 20-step walkthrough and attached companion states were generated at both authoritative viewports; acceptance remains a separate gate.

fixture.isolation: A reset runtime and an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 port per viewport.

capture_limits.news: All displayed news states are simulated browser responses at the fixture clock; they are not live provider/cache/deadline evidence.
capture_limits.csp: Annotation captures use bypassCSP=true only for injected labels; separate first-paint execution observations use bypassCSP=false.
capture_limits.mobile: Chromium mobile/touch emulation at 390x844, not native or physical-phone evidence.
capture_limits.animation: Reduced motion plus capture-only disabled animations; static PNGs are authoritative.

step_definitions.title: Confirm the local service and backup status
step_definitions.description: Open the dashboard and confirm that the status line says ready, fixture provider, and backup available.
step_definitions.caption: The ready status identifies deterministic fixture data and says managed backups are available; backup and restore are not exposed in the UI.
step_definitions.altText: Dashboard masthead with ready, fixture provider, and backup available status labels.

step_definitions.title: Use company-name lookup
step_definitions.description: Type ProFrac in the instrument field, then choose ProFrac Holding Corp. from the result list.
step_definitions.caption: The ProFrac query returns one selectable ACDC stock result.
step_definitions.altText: Instrument search containing ProFrac with a ProFrac Holding Corp., ACDC result card.

step_definitions.title: Confirm the selected symbol identity
step_definitions.description: Press Arrow Down and Enter, or tap the result, then check the confirmed ACDC identity before continuing.
step_definitions.caption: The confirmation shows ACDC, NMS, USD, America/New_York, and Stock.
step_definitions.altText: Confirmed identity panel for ProFrac Holding Corp. showing symbol ACDC and stock metadata.

step_definitions.title: Run the stock forecast
step_definitions.description: Select Stock, run the ACDC forecast, and compare the Close → next close and Completed 5m → close cards.
step_definitions.caption: The ACDC result presents direction probabilities for both forecast origins.
step_definitions.altText: ACDC forecast comparison with close-to-close and completed-five-minute-to-close result cards.

step_definitions.title: Read a chart point and its table equivalent
step_definitions.description: Focus the −10% chart point, read its 0.6% probability, then continue to the matching Return at or below −10% table row.
step_definitions.caption: The focused −10% point and the continuation table row both report 0.6%.
step_definitions.altText: Focused minus-ten-percent chart point with a tooltip reporting 0.6 percent at or below minus ten percent.

step_definitions.title: Run the ETF forecast
step_definitions.description: Enter SPY, select ETF, run the forecast, and compare the same two forecast horizons.
step_definitions.caption: The SPY ETF result uses the close-to-close and completed-five-minute-to-close origins.
step_definitions.altText: SPY ETF forecast with two horizon cards and direction probabilities.

step_definitions.title: Search and filter the ledger
step_definitions.description: Set symbol to SPY, status to Successful, and asset type to ETF; select Filter ledger and inspect the matching result.
step_definitions.caption: The active filters narrow the ledger to the successful SPY ETF event.
step_definitions.altText: History ledger filtered to a single successful SPY ETF result.

step_definitions.title: Reopen the immutable saved forecast
step_definitions.description: Select Reopen saved forecast on the SPY event and confirm the immutable recorded-result label.
step_definitions.caption: Saved event 2 reopens as an immutable recorded SPY result.
step_definitions.altText: Reopened SPY forecast headed Immutable recorded result and audit event 2.

step_definitions.title: Run a fresh historical-cutoff analysis
step_definitions.description: Select Run fresh cutoff analysis and verify that the new calculation is labelled Not the saved forecast.
step_definitions.caption: Fresh event 3 appears separately with its historical cutoff and leaves the saved result unchanged.
step_definitions.altText: Fresh analysis panel labelled Not the saved forecast with a new event and historical cutoff.

step_definitions.title: Download the filtered CSV and JSON
step_definitions.description: Keep the SPY, Successful, and ETF filters active; select Download CSV and Download JSON to save history.csv and history.json.
step_definitions.caption: The two download controls export the currently filtered SPY history in CSV and JSON formats.
step_definitions.altText: Filtered history controls with Download CSV and Download JSON links visible.

step_definitions.title: Follow the system theme
step_definitions.description: Choose System in the theme control and confirm that the dashboard follows the current dark system preference.
step_definitions.caption: System is selected while the dashboard follows a dark operating-system preference.
step_definitions.altText: Dark dashboard masthead with System selected in the color theme control.

step_definitions.title: Choose explicit dark mode
step_definitions.description: Choose Dark in the theme control and confirm that the dashboard changes to the explicit dark theme.
step_definitions.caption: Dark is selected as an explicit preference rather than inherited from the system.
step_definitions.altText: Dashboard in dark colors with Dark selected in the theme control.

step_definitions.title: Reset the theme to system
step_definitions.description: Choose System again to remove the explicit theme choice and return to the current light system preference.
step_definitions.caption: System is selected and the dashboard has returned to the light system theme.
step_definitions.altText: Light dashboard masthead after the color theme control is reset to System.

step_definitions.title: Open the loaded dark API page
step_definitions.description: Choose Dark, open the local API documentation, and inspect the fully loaded dark page; first paint timing is recorded separately.
step_definitions.caption: This image shows the settled dark API page, not the earlier paint transition.
step_definitions.altText: Loaded local API documentation page using the dark theme.

step_definitions.title: Load fresh current headlines
step_definitions.description: Open current headlines and inspect all five items. Simulated response — fixture clock 10 Jan 2025, 17:03 UTC.
step_definitions.caption: The simulated fresh response shows five SPY headlines, source, as-of time, publication metadata, and safe links.
step_definitions.altText: SPY news panel with five simulated fresh headlines at the 10 January 2025 fixture clock.

step_definitions.title: Show an honest empty news result
step_definitions.description: Open current headlines and confirm the successful empty message. Simulated response — fixture clock 10 Jan 2025, 17:03 UTC.
step_definitions.caption: The simulated empty response says no current headlines were returned and does not present a provider error.
step_definitions.altText: SPY news panel showing a simulated successful empty state at the fixture clock.

step_definitions.title: Label partial headline metadata
step_definitions.description: Inspect item 1 and confirm it remains usable without publisher or publication time. Simulated response — fixture clock 10 Jan 2025, 17:03 UTC.
step_definitions.caption: In the simulated partial response, item 1 lacks publisher and time while the remaining headline data stays available.
step_definitions.altText: Simulated partial SPY headline list whose first item has no publisher or publication time.

step_definitions.title: Explain stale cached headlines
step_definitions.description: Inspect the retained cached headlines and their warning. Simulated stale fallback — fixture clock 10 Jan 2025, 17:03 UTC.
step_definitions.caption: The simulated stale fallback keeps cached headlines visible and labels the displayed as-of time as cached after refresh failure.
step_definitions.altText: Simulated stale SPY news panel with cached headlines and a refresh-failed warning.

step_definitions.title: Report provider failure without cache
step_definitions.description: Open current headlines and read the unavailable message. Simulated provider failure with no cache — fixture clock 10 Jan 2025, 17:03 UTC.
step_definitions.caption: The simulated provider failure reports that no cached headlines can be shown and remains distinct from an empty result.
step_definitions.altText: SPY news panel showing a simulated provider-unavailable state with no cached headlines.

step_definitions.title: Keep saved evidence separate from current headlines
step_definitions.description: Reopen the saved SPY forecast and leave Load current headlines for this symbol closed; use it only when current information is wanted.
step_definitions.caption: The closed disclosure keeps current headlines separate; the recorded request-count delta for saved reopen is zero.
step_definitions.altText: Immutable saved SPY forecast with the Load current headlines disclosure closed.
